entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • VS2026 .NET 9 Blazor Component Errors and Debug Loop #63997
  • Blazor [PersistentState(AllowUpdates = true)] issue with @rendermode InteractiveWebAssembly #63996
  • Microsoft.AspNet.Web.Optimization is not marked as deprecated #63995
  • Auto detect JS isulation modul file #63993
  • Page components from a Razor Class Library redirected to the NotFound page. #63987
  • Update gRPC package versions in templates prior to .NET 10 release #63986
  • Benchmark stopped running: QueryCompilation #63985

Closed

  • Reexecuted page is not interactive #63963
    10.0.0
  • After installing the asp.net core runtime 10.0 RC 2(x86), the swidtag folder is installed in the C:\Program Files path instead of C:\Program Files (x86) path #63839
    10.0.0
  • [BUG] Login loop and post-login navigation issues in Blazor WASM Hosted (.NET 8, Azure App Service) #63886
